decision.rationale: The disputed transaction TXN-008096 (ASHGROVE APPAREL, 128115 minor units EUR, on card CRD-000238) was posted on 2026-06-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 141 days later. Policy section time-limits requires a dispute to be opened within 120 days of posting and says a later dispute is declined even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. Section rule-order applies the time limit first. Authorisation AUTH-008287 looks like card-not-present fraud: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and fraud flag set. That does not override the time limit, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Your dispute was opened 141 days after the transaction was posted on 2026-06-10. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, including for transactions that may be fraudulent, so we cannot accept this one.
